dashboard_stale_diagnostics.MOTHERSON_treatment: MOTHERSON was not a stale accepted entry; live entry was timely. The observed issue was Matrix notification/display delay, fixed by non-notifying rebuilds and position-aware reducer.

fix_applied: Patched matrix-v1/scripts/sync_from_v2.py to maintain active_position_by_symbol and skip unmatched old-position exits for Matrix state transitions.
Patched matrix-v1/src/matrix_v1/app.py to ignore unmatched exit events defensively if position_id does not match active_position_id.
Tagged full Matrix rebuild payloads with matrix_rebuild_event=true and suppress_notification=true.
Reset and rebuilt Matrix from current production v2 ledgers, then restarted Matrix bridge.
prevention_for_tomorrow: Matrix bridge tails with active_position_by_symbol and will not let old-position exits override current selected-leg state.
Historical rebuild/reseed events are suppressed from Matrix notifications.
Dashboard stale diagnostics are loaded from archived RCA reports as display-only evidence, so replay correction does not erase diagnostics.
root_cause: Matrix reduced events by symbol while v2 lifecycle events are position-keyed.
A later exit belonging to an older/opposite position could neutralize a newer active selected T2 position for the same symbol.
Historical full-rebuild payloads were not explicitly marked non-notifying, so old replay events could appear as delayed Matrix notifications.
